data.text: Re-review of PR #11 (round 2): verdict CHANGES. Correctness: (1) state.go:420 step-first order puts DecisionSuperseded (rank 2) before an earlier DecisionApplied (rank 3), dropping applied info. Only force a rank-3 event after its own prerequisite, not after every rank-2 event. (2) template.html:178 --fragment script declares top-level consts; two fragments on one page throw (wrap in an IIFE). (3) links.go:27 assumes 'main' when origin/HEAD is unset, and links to the branch tip; use the commit SHA. (4) actions.go:69 a blocked draft contract with a Pending version is still offered as a freeze action. (5) projections.go:281 Lead() falls back to the untracked registry.yaml (circular); move lead to config.yaml like project. (6) state.go:401 alias map keyed by id only; key by (kind, alias). Cleanups: write.go:768 freeze and version error messages send the user in circles; cli.go:321 duplicate git remote calls; write.go:851 double read and ignored hash error; lanes.go:53 duplicate loopRole var. Fix all, or answer why not.
